facts.fact: The fee to make an inoperative PAN operative by intimating Aadhaar is Rs 1,000
facts.quote: A fee of one thousand rupees will continue to apply to make the PAN operative by intimating the Aadhaar number.

facts.fact: The fee is paid first, on the e-Filing portal under Major head 0021, Minor head 500, then Aadhaar is linked
facts.quote: 1. Payment of Aadhaar PAN link Fee on e-filing portal (under minor head 500 with in the Major head 0021 in Single challan) 2. Link Aadhaar with PAN on e-filing portal.

facts.fact: In e-Pay Tax select Type of Payment 'Other Receipts (500)' and sub-type 'Fee for delay in Linking PAN with Aadhaar'
facts.quote: Step 9: Select the relevant Tax Year, Type of Payment as Other Receipts (500), Sub type of Payment (Fee for delay in Linking Pan with Aadhaar) and click ‘Continue’.

facts.fact: Linking is mandatory under s.139AA of the 1961 Act / s.262 of the 2025 Act
facts.quote: As per the provisions of section 139AA of Income Tax Act,1961 or section 262 of Income Tax Act,2025 it is mandatory to link PAN with Aadhaar.

facts.fact: Step: on the e-Filing home page click 'Link Aadhaar' in Quick Links (or Profile after login)
facts.quote: Step 1: Visit the e-Filing Portal Home page. Click on ‘Link Aadhaar’ in Quick Links section. Alternatively, login to e-filing portal and click on ‘Link Aadhaar’ in ‘Profile’ section.

facts.fact: Step: enter PAN and Aadhaar, Validate, click 'Continue to Pay Through e-Pay Tax' and select Income Tax Act, 2025
facts.quote: Step 3 : Enter your PAN and Aadhaar Number and click ‘Validate’. Step 4: Click on ‘Continue to Pay Through e-Pay Tax’. Step 5 : Select Applicable Income Tax Act, 2025 and click ‘Continue’.

facts.fact: Step: enter PAN and mobile number, verify the OTP, then click Proceed on the 'Income Tax' tile
facts.quote: Step 6: Enter your PAN, confirm PAN, and any valid mobile number to receive OTP. Step 7 : Post OTP verification, you will be redirected to e-Pay Tax page. Click on ‘Continue’. Step 8: Click on ‘Proceed’ in the ‘Income Tax’ tile.

facts.fact: Step: the fee amount is pre-filled
facts.quote: Step 10: Applicable amount will be pre-filled against Others.

facts.fact: If the fee is already paid, wait 4-5 working days before submitting the link request
facts.quote: Note: If you have already paid the fee, then wait for 4-5 working days. After that, you can submit the request.

facts.fact: The PAN becomes operative again within 30 days of intimating Aadhaar after paying the Rs 1,000 fee (CBDT press release, 28.03.2023)
facts.quote: The PAN can be made operative again in 30 days, upon intimation of Aadhaar to the prescribed authority after payment of fee of Rs.1,000.

facts.fact: While inoperative: no refund is made against the PAN
facts.quote: i. no refund shall be made against such PANs;

facts.fact: While inoperative: no interest on refund for the period the PAN is inoperative
facts.quote: ii. interest shall not be payable on such refund for the period during which PAN remains inoperative; and

facts.fact: While inoperative: TDS and TCS apply at higher rates
facts.quote: iii. TDS and TCS shall be deducted /collected at higher rate, as provided in the Act.

facts.fact: Linking is not required for residents of Assam, J&K and Meghalaya, non-residents, persons aged 80 or more, and non-citizens
facts.quote: Aadhaar-PAN linkage requirement does not apply to any individual who is: Residing in the States of Assam, Jammu and Kashmir, and Meghalaya; a non-resident as per the Income-tax Act, 1961; of the age of eighty years or more at any time during the previous year; or not a citizen of India.

facts.fact: If details mismatch, correct them in PAN or Aadhaar; if linking still fails, use biometric authentication at PAN service provider (Protean/UTIITSL) centres
facts.quote: If linking request still fails, you are advised to avail the option of biometric based authentication at dedicated centres of PAN Service Providers (Protean & UTIITSL).

facts.fact: Step: after payment, Link Aadhaar again: Validate > Continue > enter details > 'Link Aadhaar' > enter the 6-digit OTP
facts.quote: Step 4: Enter the mandatory details as required and click on ‘Link Aadhaar’. Step 5: Enter the 6-digit OTP received on mobile number mentioned in the previous step and click on ‘Validate’.

facts.fact: Step: check the result via 'Link Aadhaar/View Status' in Quick Links
facts.quote: Step 1: On the e-Filing Portal homepage, under 'Quick Links', click 'Link Aadhaar/View Status'.

facts.fact: If names/DOB in PAN and Aadhaar do not match, correct the details in PAN (Protean/UTIITSL) or Aadhaar (UIDAI)
facts.quote: Correct your details in either PAN or Aadhaar database such that both have matching details.

summary: Rs 1,000 fee, 0021/500 challan, fee-then-link steps, s.139AA/s.262, 4-5 day wait, 30-day reactivation (2023 press release, now read directly), consequences and exemptions all confirmed on ITD pages. Added each Link Aadhaar step, the three inoperative-PAN consequences separately, and the PAN/Aadhaar mismatch correction.
